_about: Which picture events sound, with which variant and at which tier. Keys are event ids from film/events.ts; anything not listed is silent on purpose. Each entry: [sound, tier] or [sound, tier, offset in frames]. Sounds: A1_heavy A2_mid A3_mid_tight A4_soft A5_soft_dull A6_tick (shutter), B1_soft B2_mid B3_strong (lock), C1_short C2_mid C3_long C4_swell (grain). Tiers: soft -10 dB, mid -4.5 dB, strong 0 dB.
picture: v3 (footage in its own colour, the edit in bursts and in white: scan, result, flashes).

scenes.Boot: one soft grain as the system wakes
scenes.Present: hard entry: the strongest cut of the film, a soft scan lock, the brain as a soft grain, a mid type hit
scenes.Build (ring): mechanical detail: a soft negative cut, a metal lock on the ring
scenes.Train: chrome: a swell into a heavy hit; the scan is silent; the white eagle as a soft grain
scenes.Build (notebook): quiet: a soft entry, a soft lock, then the logo and the word ring on one long soft grain; the contour trace stays silent
scenes.Run: speed: mid entry, silent scan, the tiger as a quick mid grain, a soft tick on RUN
scenes.Team: calm: the cut is silent, a mid lock on the two of them, a tick for the figures
scenes.Recover: insight: a mid 1-bit cut, the orbital HUD locks on the head with the metal lock, the sword a beat later as a quick soft grain, a soft negative
scenes.Repeat: chrome again: swell into a heavy hit, a soft lock, the Spartan helmet as a soft grain
scenes.Outro: a four-shot motor drive that fades, the sparkles fly in, the strong metal lock, the wordmark grains
